text.p: Midland Resources Inc said Tuesday it had completed the John Estate No. 87 field extension well in the Jameson field in Sterling County, Texas.
The Permian Basin well tested initially at a daily rate of 79,000 cubic feet of gas and 63 barrels of oil through perforations at a depth of 6,702 to 6,807 feet, the company said.
The company also said it recompleted the Copano Bay well No. 115-1. The well is expected to stabilize at 350,000 cubic feet of gas and 30 barrels of oil per day.
The company said the wells were completed at a combined cost of $615,000, and net production to the company is expected to be 50 barrels of oil per day and 350,000 cubic feet of gas per day.
